source_copy: modified from the v0.12.0 handoff through v0.26.0; see docs/releases/v0.13.0.md to v0.26.0.md

checks.ui_controller: passed, DOM substitute + native Canvas, including alliance, outpost, winter, seasons, farlands, daily, thief, garden, gear, echo, undertow, longnight and tidy sections
checks.real_browser_layout: headless Chromium: a v0.25 save with the canner, fish trap, stall goods, the house overtime policy and the lathe on ammo read in (upgrade checkpoint and backup hold the exact old save, retired buildings gone, stall goods on the listing, overtime a decree, lathe on parts, the 营地整顿 toast); E opening the solar, lure (sounded) and trap (mended with a kit) pages; mood marks, inspiration sparkles and lure rings by day and night; tomorrow's prices on the shipping box, the residents' mood card, decree costs, the lathe and its jam sign; the long-night banner countdown, the bell rung with E calling wave 2, the dawn report; no console errors, no sideways scroll, no developer words in player text; at 1366x768, 1920x1080, 390x844 touch and 844x390 touch; earlier checks still apply; real devices, Firefox and Safari not verified
checks.independent_review: v0.15 to v0.23 each: code review + randomized play or rendering probes; v0.24 self-review with a 45-day soak; v0.25 self-review with a post-story soak (three seeds x 45 days, one seed x 85 days, 34 long nights, the ending reached); v0.26 self-review with a post-story soak (three seeds x 30 days and one seed x 75 days with three residents, two towers, four traps and a lure: the listing topped up daily, a lathe rush every other day, every long night played through with the lure sounded, the bell rung once and kits used between waves, the three counterattack steps, sleep, save and reload every day; 24 long nights, the ending reached, no errors, no NaN); the first soak run stalled on the last raid because the soak bot itself got stuck behind a tower with a broken spear (bot fixed: daily weapon repair and a nudge when stuck); other fixes this round: lathe ammo removal breaking old saves (key kept, hidden), a fractional nap minute, diligent camps pinned above 85 morale and too few inspirations, scheduled waves too easy with defences under 30% of kills, half-done canner parcels handed to the cook fire (refunded instead), stale stall/fish-trap texts, the migration water-sample bonus tied to removed fish traps, a developer-style broken-save message
checks.gear_acceptance_sim: scripts/gear-sim.mjs on the real code, 100 trips per cell, no rolls; v0.24 bot follows the in-game hints (flanks the warehouse guard and backs off its swings, interrupts and rushes spitters, walks out of gas/acid along open ground; FLANK/SMART/FEEL=0 switch them off): days 1-3 unarmed 41/55/70% deaths (residential/hospital/warehouse), right gear 1/0/5%; days 4-7 mid gear 0/4/3%, day 1-3 kit 7/12/18%; day 8+ late gear 1/9/8%, mid gear 1/14/13%; warehouse completion 59% at days 4-7 mid and day 8+ late (v0.23 65%)
checks.boss_sim: scripts/boss-sim.mjs, 100 fights per cell: brute mid/late 89/96% wins 70/71 s, nurse 100/100% 60/60 s, guard day 5 96/97% 57/59 s, guard day 9 89/94% 61/64 s, no deaths; within noise of v0.24 (the extra engine layer shifts the random stream; without the long-night layer the v0.25 files reproduce v0.24 exactly)
checks.loot_sim: scripts/loot-sim.mjs, 1000 days: identical to v0.24 (value per trip +5.9% at day 8+ odds; hospital +14.1%)
checks.performance: headless Chromium 1366x768, v0.24 and v0.25 measured alternately on the same machine: ready-to-continue 2.0-2.4 s -> 1.3-1.9 s; first frame entering each of the 14 maps 167-450 ms -> at most 33 ms; farm frames while other maps bake in the background max 33 ms (p99 17 ms); 1920x1080 night storm 47.7-58.8 fps (long night with 22 infected 51.6 fps)
checks.longnight_sim: v0.26: scripts/gear-sim.mjs 400 38 longnight mid with LNSET, first long night, 400 nights per cell (200 marked): alone with bench 40.3% down; two towers + four traps + three guards 9.0% (defence 31% of kills), with repairs between waves 9.8%; four towers + eight traps + repairs 4.0% (49%); eight traps + repairs 6.3% (traps 19% of kills); lure + four traps sounded 11.3% (trap kills 10.3) vs not sounded 23.5% (4.5); bare alone (200) 91.5%; BELL=late four towers + eight traps (200) 15.0% down, boss killed 24% (without the bell 3 of 400 nights); horde mode (200 each, round 8+, 36 infected): damage taken alone 55, two towers + four traps 48, four towers + eight traps 0, eight traps 42; v0.25 (100 per cell): prepared 28% down, bare alone 81%
checks.origin_sim: ORIGIN=... scripts/gear-sim.mjs start on the real code, 300 trips per hospital/warehouse cell and 100 per residential cell, every origin crafts the wooden spear: death rates within 5 points of the farmer on days 1 and 3 (farmer 0/11.7/24.0% and 0/9.3/21.0%; medic -4.7/-5.0 and -1.3/-5.0; hunter 0/-2.3 and +0.7/-1.7; mechanic -3.0/-3.7 and +0.7/-0.3; veteran -4.7/+1.0 and -1.3/+4.0); with the design kits the medic (2 medkits) was -8.3 in the warehouse and the veteran (leather jacket) -8.7 in the hospital on day 1, so the medic carries 1 medkit and the veteran ammo 10 instead of the jacket; a veteran using his pipe dies 41% in the warehouse
checks.camp_sims: v0.26 on the real code: scripts/mood-bench.mjs 30 1,2,3: high mood +25.4% work, low -39.6%; diligent camp average morale 73.8, busy 53.5, busy with overtime 44.6, neglected 27.3 (low most days); inspirations 0.72 per high person-week (with the design's 55 home and 12% they were 85.6 and 0.43); scripts/farm-bench.mjs (7 diligent and 6 busy scenarios, 3 seeds x 30 days): crops, actions and resident work hours identical to the v0.25 checkup; listing: 0.5 presses a day keeps three slots full, 10 sold a day, +56 gold a day over the shipping box for potatoes (+69 tomatoes, +20 bread)

alliance_overhaul_status: acts 1-8 complete (v0.13.0-v0.15.0); expansion plan v0.15-v0.17 items all implemented
upkeep_change: player hunger ~2.8x original rate, sleep costs extra hunger, starvation faints; residents/helpers eat two meals a day (18:00 dinner); food-days HUD
winter_change: three-day cold snap after a forecast: warm zones, stove fuel, +40% hunger outside warm zones, crop and crew slowdowns, camp chills; decree book, living standard, radio, museum
seasons_change: festivals every 7 days, adjacency bonuses, canteen nights, campfire talks, apprentices, lodgers, six NPCs, calendar, people page, E chooser, item links, new-feature marks
farlands_change: night choices with amends, daily hazards (fog/migration/drift) with forecast, dog bond and skills, 彭姐 neighbour-camp arc, 贺满仓 interest-free building advances, raiders hit residents/crew/fences, crew task animations, daily shipping price drift, path guidance with edge arrows, narrow-screen quick menu, large text / colour-blind / calm options, letter-key remapping and gamepad
daily_change: a three-option event card pops up at 06:00 every day from day 2 and cannot be dismissed until chosen; 100 events (9 chains of 36 steps with perks at their endings, 64 standalone events in six categories, 13 newbie events for days 2-5); costs, gains, success chances and follow-ups shown per option; x1.5 rewards from act 3 and x2 from act 6, locked per chain; fixed rolls per card; buffs, delayed gifts/debts/night losses, supply caches and chain markers in the world, bounties, ambushes, crew joins; journal strip, choice record page and HUD buff chip
thief_change: skills and talents (a new thief skill levelled only by stealing; 26 talents across five skills; points from skill levels and story acts, max 28 of 48; respec 100 gold every 7 days); pickpocketing by crouching next to a person: a preview with odds per tier (words until the see-through talent), a fixed per-day dice gate and a timing mini game with an attention bar; junk/normal/important/treasure tiers with level and value caps; 20 unique treasures (tech unlocks, permanent discounts, stashes, tunnels, grants, job manuals), lost for good on a failed attempt; caught choice card (apologise/bluff/run), suspicion, strikes, crew leaving, market price rise and ban, amends; hot goods and fences; practice dummy, lockboxes, planting; 7 thief daily cards; journal strip and thief book
garden_change: the camp manual hub is gone: E at a place opens only that place's page, titled with the place name; former manual-only pages moved to the cook fire, workbench, weapon bench, shipping box, farmhouse and the farm board; farming: seed picker at the plot (bag and storage seeds), readable plots (fertility strip, weeds, caterpillars, crow footprints, cover cloth, swaying ripe crops, growth ring and care score over the head), companion buffs (water/yield/quality/weed) for different neighbouring crops, rotation and feeding/heavy soils, liked and hated weather with cover cloth, tending (helper 阿禾 from day 5), weeds to fodder, caterpillars to bait, crows and a scarecrow, a care score deciding fine quality (daily cap 65, 80+ always fine), hand-harvest combo, first three days grow 1.5x; farm board with stats, 3-day forecast and crop table; new garden save field, 2 items and the scarecrow; old saves load as is
visual_change: new code-drawn original pixel art for all 15 maps (1 art pixel = 2x2 map units; layout, colliders, exits and interaction points unchanged; the four ruin maps no longer share one picture), pixel people with 4-frame walks and job outfits, five infected types, buildings, objects, crops and plot markers; item icons, animals and the nest pixelized from the original sheets; four-part day light with window/lamp/neon/fire lights, visible rain with puddles, storms with lightning, snow at the frost station, fog in the pine forest, an indoor shelter, heat haze and particles; wood-and-rust UI with a pixel font (Fusion Pixel, SIL OFL 1.1) for titles, numbers and buttons and a generated colour layer that keeps every state colour; a new/old visual switch in v0.21.0 only (removed in v0.22.0; ember-farm-visual-v1 is no longer read or written)
gear_change: v0.22.0: infected in three phases (days 1-3, 4-7, 8+) outside the farm with packs guarding the loot (day 8+ hospital and warehouse keep the day 4-7 counts); grabs, runner lunges, screams that call new infected, armoured charges, hearing, harder nights and crawlers, all telegraphed; shove (X/LT/touch), heavy-hit interrupts, swing stamina, 0.45 s i-frames, heal over time, bleeding, infection bar and fever; five armour slots, three weapon slots and a trap, 19 armour pieces and 20 weapons with durability, bench repairs (5 max), spares, dismantling, nine mods and seven blueprints; gear panel in the bag, repairs on the weapon bench page, status chips, upgrade card; worn gear and telegraphs drawn; old saves load as is with gear equipped, a 3-day grace and a starter outfit past day 3; new gear save field; the new/old visual switch is removed
feel_change: v0.23.0: sound made in code (92 effects, 11 instruments, 13 ambience beds; six music pieces following tension, six stingers, ten ambience sets on all fifteen maps with rain, thunder and snow; infected voices and telegraph sounds with distance, panning and wall muffling; four volumes and a sound-cue line in the preferences key; sliced rendering after load, nothing rendered without Web Audio); hitstop by weapon class, lean and stagger, bodies and blood marks, heavy-hit shake; dodge roll on Space / pad B / a touch button (110 in 0.35 s, first 0.25 s safe, 15 stamina, heavier gear rolls shorter and costs more); daily card can be put off until noon (a truly free option is taken, otherwise it comes back), quiet nights give a one-line note, a today box at the top of the journal; a teaching wave on new games at 13:00 that cannot kill, then fence the east road for a rag hood; help lists eleven keys, a held Tab opens a radial at the cursor; career record (last 200 trips) in the achievements book; new feel save field, no new save keys; old saves get a one-time Space note
undertow_change: v0.24.0: 9 candidate containers per ruin with 4-5 lit a day by save seed, seven kinds and four tiers by phase (30% second draw), locked cabinets pried with a crowbar (8 s, loud) or the lockpick talent (4 s, quiet), rare/precious flash and sound, kill drops by kind; three enemy layouts per ruin and phase; seven ruin events from day 2 (trapped survivor escort with crew join, airdrop, corpse pile, storeroom, raider search party, backpacker, walkie-talkie); bloater and faker from day 4, spitter and stalker from day 8, replacing walkers one for one; brute and nurse every 7 days in their ruins (announced the day before), the warehouse guard strengthened from day 4 (front armour, slow turn, uninterruptible swings at 0.7 damage, phase-two charges, keeps to its post); boss bar without popups, doubled first win and trophies for a sixth museum case; radio at 07:00, curfew keeps prowling stalkers off the farm, three daily cards (116 total), the dog growls at fakers; 45 new sound effects; new undertow save field with strict validation, old saves get their own seed, no new save keys
longnight_change: v0.25.0: long nights every 7 days after act 8 (day 7n+3, from two days after the story ends): red date at 08:00, red sky and thunder from 18:00, a warning at 21:00 when away, a scream at 22:00 that brings you home; three waves at 22:00/00:00/02:00 (or 20 s after a wave is cleared) of 10/12/14 with the new infected, max 22 alive, the third with a brute or nurse when it thins (0.8 HP); held at 04:00 or when everything is down, failed by going down (nothing lost beyond the usual death rules); x1.2 per night held up to x2; gold, rare draws, three mementos for a seventh museum case, a dawn report with a nap to 08:00, an ending card and archive broadcast after ten; guards stay on past midnight; regular hordes and raids moved off long nights; Grey Falcon counterattack (scouts on day +5 in a ruin, their map; saboteurs on day +7 at 23:00 planting for 11 s; the last raid on day +10 at 19:00 with the leader 隼头: 360 HP, 14-damage shots, smoke every 12 s that halves your damage and blinds towers and guards, the rest flee when he falls; retry two days after a loss); five origins on new game (farmer, medic, hunter, mechanic, veteran) and new game plus from the settings (blueprints, achievements snapshot, career, one gear piece at full durability, checkpoint first); new longnight save field with strict validation, no new save keys
polish_change: v0.25.0: 147 item icons and the chickens, goat, sheep and dog redrawn in code (4-frame walks); maps baked in a Web Worker (the current map from page open via a small inline script, the others in the background, a dark veil up to 1.5 s if a map is not ready), all 115 modules modulepreloaded (scripts/modulepreload.mjs keeps index.html in sync), old-style district/frontier art drawn only when needed, the farm terrain bake faster with the same pixels, event saves deferred to idle time and the previous save not re-parsed; settings show the last export day, a weekly export reminder after sleeping and a save-failure prompt with an export button
tidy_change: v0.26.0: camp tidy-up from the facility checkup: canner and fish trap retired with full refunds (parcels on the cook fire; the migration water-sample bonus moved from fish traps to rainy-day pond catches), the stall merged into the shipping box as a three-slot listing (one piece every 90 min by day at 1.25x), house work/food policies merged into the overtime and injured-first decrees, the lathe's ammo mode replaced by repair kits, mule cargo bringing one cart back instead of lasting perks, apprentices on the crew card with role retraining; old saves converted once (checkpoint first, toast, next-morning list); three mood tiers from a per-person target (50 + listed reasons, 40% drift a night): low idles 40% of hours and sulks 10% of days, high does one more job 25% of hours and has 20% inspirations at 08:00 (lucky harvest, free medkits, everything mended, sharp-eyed towers; trust 3 reveals); 17 facility pages on E with real buttons, five new alerts plus Hemc due dates and the bell; long-night waves at 22:00/00:00/02:00 and the boss at 03:00 with a bell to call them early (two a night, one more rare draw each), waves 12/15/18, traps hit every infected (x1.34, bosses half, raiders spot half), towers only with ready guards (x1.2, lit at night, grey on the defence view), the noise lure sounded by hand (96 minutes, 5 power or a part), the repair post only in fights with a tally; tomorrow's shipping price; Hemc installments due every 3 days with lateness fees and a 7-day refusal; lathe rush with 20% jams; new tidy save field with strict validation, no new save keys
